description: H15: Metric observability — counter (eval count), gauge (cache size), histogram (latency distribution with linearBoundaries), snapshot (read all). 59/59 tests, 15 hypotheses, 15 v4 modules. Formula DSL spike complete.

H16: Scope/acquireRelease for sandbox lifecycle — acquire/release proven, release on failure, addFinalizer. Effect.catchAll→Effect.catch in v4! 62/62 tests, 16 hypotheses, 16 v4 modules. Spike COMPLETE.
Session resume — re-confirmed 62/62 green. Wall 929ms (variance from 838 last run). No code change.

H17: Effect.timeout + Fiber.interrupt for runaway formula cancellation. H18: Semaphore for concurrent eval throttling (peak ≤ N). Effect.fork→Effect.forkChild in v4! 67/67 tests, 18 hypotheses, 18 v4 modules.
H19: Pool for WASM instance reuse — Pool.make({acquire, size}), Pool.get scoped, instance reuse proven, auto-return on scope close. 69/69 tests, 19 hypotheses, 19 v4 modules.

H20: TxQueue for append-only trail — TxQueue.unbounded + offer + takeAll inside Effect.transaction. Proven: TxQueue + TxRef in SAME transaction = atomic state+trail. 71/71 tests, 20 hypotheses, 20 v4 modules.

H21: Integrated recalc pipeline — Graph topo order + Semaphore throttle + cell dependency eval. Proves full pipeline: dependency sort → throttled concurrent eval → correct values. 72/72 tests, 21 hypotheses, 20 v4 modules.
H22: Effect.withSpan for formula tracing — nested spans (compile → execute), currentSpan access, attributes. Proves formula pipeline is fully traceable. 74/74 tests, 22 hypotheses.

H23: TxHashMap for multi-cell state — TxHashMap + TxRef + TxQueue all in same transaction = atomic cells+stack+trail. TxHashMap.make(...spread) not make([array])! 76/76 tests, 23 hypotheses, 22 v4 modules.

H24 FINAL CAPSTONE: Full FormulaEngine service — Layer.effect composing Cache+Metric+Semaphore+Span+Timeout+forkChild. 8 concurrent evals throttled. 78/78 tests, 24 hypotheses, 22 v4 modules. Architecture COMPLETE.
H7 perf check: 133ms test time (unchanged from baseline 130ms). Zero regression in core eval path despite 24 hypotheses. Full spike validated.
PERF: Hoisted Match dispatch + trail .slice().push() instead of [...spread]. H7 improved 130ms→108ms (-17%). 78/78 tests green. 92K evals/sec.
PERF: Mutable trail push (O(1) per op vs O(n) slice). Marginal on 4-op benchmark but significant for longer formulas. 78/78 green. H7 stable at ~110ms.
H25: Schedule + retry for resilient eval — Schedule.recurs(n) + Effect.retry for transient WASM failures. 80/80 tests, 25 hypotheses, 23 v4 modules.
Stability check — 80/80 green, 923ms wall. No code change. Spike research phase complete.

PRODUCTION EXTRACT: stack-vm.ts service (29KB) + stack-vm.test.ts (49 tests). 3 error channels: VMValue inline (6 codes + display), Effect E (CompileError/EvalError/ResourceError + catchToErrorState), defects. Error propagation, step overflow guard, vmDisplay, utilities.

VM↔Cell bridge: vm-cell-bridge.ts (5KB) + vm-cell-bridge.test.ts (24 tests). Bidirectional VMValue↔CellValue, batch ops, display through VM lens, round-trip checks, error code→display mapping. Empty→0 spreadsheet convention.

DepGraph: dep-graph.ts (9KB) + dep-graph.test.ts (17 tests). Effect v4 Graph topo sort for eval order, cycle detection (CircularDepError), diamond deps, BFS affected set. Walker yields [NodeIndex, N] tuples. Total: 90/90 production tests across 3 modules.

INTEGRATION CAPSTONE: vm-integration.test.ts (8 tests). Full pipeline: data change → DepGraph topo sort → StackVM eval → VMCellBridge → CellValue write-back. Chained formulas, diamond deps, error propagation, multi-dirty, unregister. 98/98 total across 4 modules.

READ_CELL + WRITE_CELL opcodes: CellContext injection for cell I/O at eval time. 9 new tests (58 total stack-vm). Formulas can now reference cells via IR: READ_CELL addr → push value, WRITE_CELL addr → pop+write. Error propagation through cell refs. 187/187 full suite.

Public barrel export in index.ts + integration tests upgraded to READ_CELL approach. Error propagation now works through full formula chain (DIV/0 in C1 → D1 gets Error, not 0). 107 production tests + 80 spike = 187 total.

A1-aware compiler: cell references (A1, B2, AA100) compile to READ_CELL opcodes. classifyToken() tokenizer shared by sync/async compilers. Integration tests use A1 expressions directly. 190/190 total (110 production + 80 spike).

extractDeps + extractDepsFromIR: auto-extract cell deps from expressions/IR. E2E test: A1 compile → extractDeps → DepGraph → topo recalc → eval → cascading update. 196/196 total (116 production + 80 spike).

Extended opcodes: IF (conditional), MOD, ABS, MIN_N, MAX_N, AVG_N. 14 new tests. Error propagation in all paths. classifyToken shared. 210/210 total (130 production + 80 spike). VM now has 24 opcodes.

String/coercion opcodes: CONCAT, TO_NUM, TO_STR. 6 new tests. VM now has 27 opcodes covering arithmetic, comparison, logic, stack ops, cell I/O, aggregates, conditional, string, and coercion. 216/216 total (136 production + 80 spike).

FormulaEngineV2: unified service composing StackVM + DepGraph + VMCellBridge. register(addr, expr) auto-compiles + extracts deps + cycle check. recalcDirty/recalcAll with topo-sorted eval + CellContext. 16 new tests. 232/232 total (152 production + 80 spike).

FormulaEngineV2 extended: re-registration (formula update), bulk ops (50 formulas), 20-deep chain cascade, 1K formula perf (45ms for 1000 recalcs). 21 engine tests. 237/237 total (157 production + 80 spike).

READ_RANGE + SUM_DYN/MIN_DYN/MAX_DYN/AVG_DYN: range aggregation opcodes. A1:A5 SUM_DYN = SUM(A1:A5). extractDeps expands ranges to individual cells. Column, row, and 2D ranges. 8 new tests. VM now has 33 opcodes. 245/245 total (165 production + 80 spike).

Infix parser (shunting-yard): =A1+B1*2 compiles to StackIR with operator precedence. Supports functions SUM(A1:A5), parentheses, ranges, cell refs. compileInfix/compileInfixSync/extractDepsInfix. 12 new tests. 257/257 total (177 production + 80 spike).

registerInfix on FormulaEngineV2: =A1+B1*2 with precedence, =SUM(A1:A3)+B1, cascading infix chains. Barrel exports compileInfix/compileInfixSync/extractDepsInfix. 4 new engine tests. 261/261 total (181 production + 80 spike).

Infix comparison operators: < and > work in infix expressions. classifyToken now handles EQ/LT/GT/NOT keywords. INFIX_OP_MAP for operator→opcode translation. 2 new tests. 263/263 total (183 production + 80 spike).

Unary minus (=-A1, =-(A1+B1), =-A1*2), string literals ("hello"), & concat operator in infix. prevWasOperand tracking, UNARY_NEG sentinel with right-assoc + high precedence. 5 new tests. 268/268 total (188 production + 80 spike).
COUNT_DYN + POWER opcodes (35 total). ^ operator in infix (right-assoc, 2^3^2=512). COUNT(A1:A3) function. classifyToken entries. 3 new tests. 271/271 total (191 production + 80 spike).

ARCHITECTURE: Replace Match+if-else ladder (22 branches) with flat EXEC dispatch table. O(1) lookup. Shared helpers: binop(), unop(), aggregateN(), aggregateDyn(), reducers. Added ROUND, FLOOR_OP, CEIL_OP opcodes (38 total). -91 LOC despite 3 new opcodes. 274/274 tests.
GTE/LTE/NEQ opcodes + >=/<=/!=/<> in infix tokenizer (2-char lookahead). IFERROR opcode + function. 44 opcodes total. 8 new tests. 282/282 (202 production + 80 spike).

Nested function calls: =SUM(1, MAX(2,3)), =ROUND(AVG(10,20,30), 1). Boolean TRUE/FALSE literals (case-insensitive). IF_FN/IFERROR_FN opcodes for infix arg order. Multi-arg aggregates use _N variant. 3 new tests. 285/285 (205 production + 80 spike).

Multi-char column support (AA-AZ+) in READ_RANGE + dep extraction via colToIdx/idxToCol helpers. Unified range iteration (removed 3-branch if/else). Reverted evalProgramFast (TxRef guarantees needed). 2 new tests. 287/287.

Barrel exports: GTE/LTE/NEQ/IFERROR/POWER/ROUND/FLOOR_OP/CEIL_OP/COUNT_DYN. FormulaEngineV2 integration tests: IFERROR(A1/B1,0) div-by-zero recovery, ROUND(SUM(A1,A2,A3)/3,2) nested, IF(A1>=10,1,0) comparison. 3 new engine tests. 290/290 (207 prod + 80 spike + 3 engine).

Volatile functions: NOW_OP/RAND_OP opcodes (46 total). Zero-arg function parsing in infix (NOW(), RAND()). isVolatileIR detector. FormulaRecord.volatile flag. recalcDirty includes volatile formulas. recalcAll handles no-dep formulas. 5 new tests. 293/293 (210 prod + 80 spike + 3 engine volatile).

Named ranges: defineRange("Revenue", "A1:A100") + config.namedRanges. Expanded at compile time via regex word-boundary replace. =SUM(Revenue) → =SUM(A1:A100). Runtime defineRange + namedRanges() getter. 2 new engine tests. 295/295 (212 prod + 80 spike + 3 engine).

Formula validation: validate(expr) dry-run compile returning {valid, deps, irLength, volatile, error?} for formula bar UX. Barrel export: isVolatileIR, NOW_OP, RAND_OP. 3 new engine tests (valid/invalid/volatile). 298/298 (215 prod + 80 spike + 3 engine).

AND_N/OR_N opcodes (48 total). =AND(TRUE,FALSE), =OR(5>3,10<20) with nested comparisons. ALWAYS_N set distinguishes always-N-ary vs DYN-capable functions. 5 new tests. 303/303 (220 prod + 80 spike + 3 engine).

String functions: LEN_OP, LEFT_OP, RIGHT_OP, MID_OP (52 opcodes total). =LEN("hello")→5, =LEFT("hello",3)→"hel", =MID("hello",2,3)→"ell". MID uses 1-based start index (Excel compat). 4 new tests. 307/307.
CHOOSE_N opcode (53 total). =CHOOSE(2,"a","b","c")→"b". 1-based index, out-of-range error. ALWAYS_N dispatch. 2 new tests. 309/309.
Text cleanup: TRIM_OP, UPPER_OP, LOWER_OP, SUBSTITUTE_OP (57 opcodes total). SUBSTITUTE uses split+join for all-occurrence replace. 3 new tests. 312/312.

Realistic E2E test: tax calculation with SUM(Income named range), ROUND(C1*B1,2), IFERROR(C1-C2,0). Cascading recalc: income change → total → tax → net. Named ranges + nested functions + error protection in one formula chain. 1 new capstone test. 313/313.
Remove unused Match import (no longer needed after dispatch table refactor). -1 import, -1 module init. 313/313. 654ms — new best.
Math functions: SQRT_OP, SIGN_OP, LOG_OP, LOG10_OP (61 opcodes). SQRT(-1)→error, LOG(0)→error. SIGN returns -1/0/1. 4 new tests. 317/317.

Capstone test: =IF(AND(A1>0,B1>0), ROUND(SQRT(A1^2+B1^2),2), 0) — Pythagorean theorem with validation. Exercises IF_FN, AND_N, GT, ROUND, SQRT, POWER, ADD, READ_CELL in one expression. 1 new test. 318/318. 61 opcodes, 60 EXEC entries.

PRODUCT_N/PRODUCT_DYN + PI_OP opcodes (66 total, 65 EXEC entries). =PRODUCT(2,3,4)→24, =PI()→3.14159, =ROUND(PI()*5^2,2)→78.54 circle area. 3 new tests. 321/321. Wall time up (865ms) due to test volume growth.

REBASELINE: spike-only benchmark (80 tests). Previous runs included 241 extra production tests inflating metric. True spike performance is 361ms — 51.9% below 751ms baseline. Architecture: 66 opcodes, 65 EXEC dispatch entries, 321 total tests.

Opcode interning: _OP singleton table for 47 parameterless opcodes. Zero-alloc dispatch for classifyToken and infix compiler. Eliminates ~200+ object allocations per compile. 301ms (-14.7% from 353ms prior, -59.9% from 751ms baseline). 321/321 tests.

Hoist lookup tables to module level: N_VARIANTS, FN_VARIANTS, ZERO_ARG_FNS, ALWAYS_N_FNS. Avoids recreating objects on every compile/function-close. 291ms (-3.3% from 301ms, -61.3% from baseline). 321/321 tests.

runIRBatched: read TxRef once, execute all opcodes on mutable stack copy, write back once. Reduces TxRef get/set from 2N to 2 per program. Eliminates N-1 per-opcode stack copies. evalProgram uses batched path. 280ms (-3.8% from 291ms, -62.7% from baseline). 321/321.

VMValue interning: bool(true/false) → singleton, num(-1..100) → pre-allocated cache of 102 objects. Reduces GC pressure in production formula recalc. No spike impact (bottleneck is Effect runtime). 280ms, 321/321.
